u8g2_robot_eyes_init.message0: create U8g2 robot eyes %1 using display object %2 style %3 width %4 height %5 frame rate %6 auto update in loop %7
u8g2_robot_eyes_init.tooltip: Create robot eyes with an initialized full-buffer U8g2 object; the style is selected at compile time and one program can use only one style

u8g2_robot_eyes_set_expression.tooltip: Smoothly transition to the selected expression, continuing from the current pose if another transition is active

u8g2_robot_eyes_set_gaze.message0: %1 set gaze X %2 Y %3 transition duration %4 ms
u8g2_robot_eyes_set_gaze.tooltip: Move the gaze smoothly; recommended range is -8..8 for X and -7..7 for Y

u8g2_robot_eyes_center_gaze.tooltip: Move the gaze smoothly back to the center

u8g2_robot_eyes_set_auto_blink.message0: %1 auto blink enabled %2 base interval %3 random variation %4 ms
u8g2_robot_eyes_set_auto_blink.tooltip: Enable or disable random automatic blinking and configure its base interval and variation

u8g2_robot_eyes_set_idle.tooltip: Enable or disable non-blocking random gaze motion

u8g2_robot_eyes_render.tooltip: update limits frame rate, clears, and sends the buffer; draw renders and sends immediately; drawToBuffer only draws for composition with other U8g2 content

u8g2_robot_eyes_expression.tooltip: Return the current target expression number from 0 to 19

u8g2_robot_eyes_is_animating.tooltip: Test whether an expression or gaze transition is still active

u8g2_robot_eyes_style.tooltip: Return the compile-time style number: 0 for square eyes and 1 for round eyes
